scripts.build: uv run --no-project python scripts/with_env.py -- corepack pnpm --dir web build
scripts.dev: uv run --no-project python scripts/with_env.py -- corepack pnpm --dir web dev
scripts.stop-app-containers: docker compose -f auth-server/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.development down && docker compose -f postgres/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.development down && docker compose -f local-mail-server/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.start-gateway: docker compose -f local-mail-server/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && docker compose -f api-gateway/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --wait && docker compose -f postgres/docker-compose.gateway.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --wait && docker compose -f auth-server/docker-compose.gateway.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --build --wait && docker compose -f web/docker-compose.gateway.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --build --wait
scripts.stop-gateway: docker compose -f web/docker-compose.gateway.yml down && docker compose -f auth-server/docker-compose.gateway.yml down && docker compose -f postgres/docker-compose.gateway.yml down && docker compose -f api-gateway/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f local-mail-server/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.web:build: uv run --no-project python scripts/with_env.py -- corepack pnpm --dir web build
scripts.web:typecheck: uv run --no-project python scripts/with_env.py -- corepack pnpm --dir web typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm --dir web lint && corepack pnpm web:typecheck
